messages.author: d8abd016b0de9d0d
messages.subject: object 'input' not found
parts:
Hallo,

I have a problem when i run my app in rstudio.
I get this failure:
Error in as.POSIXlt(input$adate) : object 'input' not found.

Could someone help me?

Thanks in advance.

This is my code:

library(shiny)

shinyUI(
  pageWithSidebar(

    # Application title
    headerPanel("Some Datas about your birthday"),

    sidebarPanel(
      dateInput("date", "Please enter your birthday(yyyy-mm-dd):")
    ),

    # Show table and plot
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("table"),
      plotOutput("distPlot")
    )
  )
)
----------------------------------------------------------
library(shiny)
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  rm(list = ls())
  
  Today=as.POSIXlt(Sys.Date())
  
#   Date=as.POSIXlt(input$date)
#   
#   BirthDate=as.POSIXlt(as.Date(Date))

  BirthDate=as.POSIXlt(input$date)
  
  BirthDate_Table=data.frame(Birthday=as.POSIXlt(character()))
  
  counter=1
  
  while(BirthDate<Today){
    BirthDate_Table[counter,]=as.character(BirthDate)
    BirthDate$year=BirthDate$year+1
    counter=counter+1
  }
  
  BirthDate_Table$Day=strftime(BirthDate_Table$Birthday,"%A")
  BirthDate_Table$Age=0:(nrow(BirthDate_Table)-1)
  BirthDate_Table$count=1
  
  require(reshape2)
  Temp1=melt(BirthDate_Table,id=c("Day"),measure.vars=c("count"),variable.name="count")
  Temp2= dcast(Temp1, Day ~ count,sum)
  


  output$table= renderTable({BirthDate_Table[,1:3]})
  output$distPlot= renderPlot({

    require(ggplot2)
    p= ggplot(Temp2, aes(Day, count))
    p=p + geom_point(color="blue",size=5)
    p=p + labs(title="Birthdays distribution over Weekday")+labs(x="weekday")+labs(y="Frequence")
    p

  })

})

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: object 'input' not found
parts:
Is this all the code? I don't see input$adate anywhere...

Anyway, on inspection, your server.R needs to be refactored into "reactive" style. Example:

  BirthDate=as.POSIXlt(input$date)
needs to become
  BirthDate=reactive(as.POSIXlt(input$date))

and then you access the BirthDate value by calling it like a function: BirthDate()

Also this whole chunk that generates BirthDate_Table needs to be rewritten like this:

BirthDate_Table=reactive({
  result=data.frame(Birthday=as.POSIXlt(character()))
  
  counter=1
  
  birthDate=BirthDate()
  while(birthDate<Today){
    result[counter,]=as.character(birthDate)
    birthDate$year=birthDate$year+1
    counter=counter+1
  }
  
  result$Day=strftime(result$Birthday,"%A")
  result$Age=0:(nrow(result)-1)
  result$count=1
  return(result)
})

and similarly, any other reactive or output that needs to access BirthDate_Table would call BirthDate_Table().

See http://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/lesson6/ for more information.
